style: 3D cartoon, Pixar, dry deadpan satire, vertical 9:16 frame, taller than wide
motion_rule: he is at full stride in the first frame and never stops striding the ledge; the camera orbits him every beat and reverses the orbit at 0.40, 1.80, 4.30 and 7.20, the cliff face raking past a horn away; ONE sideways move per beat, never chained; new shot size each beat; his muzzle never under a third of frame, jaw visible; the suits plunge across frame, never straight down
character: a shaggy markhor with huge corkscrew horns and a long beard, striding along a narrow ledge, muzzle and jaw clear
second_characters: A SWARM of investors in grey suits crowding the ledge and tipping off it, ONE of them plunging a shoulder from the lens every beat, two inside the first second, at 0.15 and 0.65; all of them moving
props: A SWARM of grey paper contracts torn out of the falling suits and whipping across the lens; ONE briefcase in the last investor's fist
prop_continuity: contracts fly off with every suit from 0.00, the briefcase rides in that fist until 7.20
environment: a bright ledge packed wall to wall with shuffling suits, a jagged cliff a horn away raking the lens, a lone pine on the far wall across the chasm, white fog and lit peaks below
light_events: white noon over the peaks, glare off the fog sweeping him every beat, a hard rim on his horns

audio.delivery: a level male chest voice around 130 Hz, unhurried, biting off each word, even 4.3 syllables per second, beats filled edge to edge
audio.pronunciation: ro-GA, za-KRU-che-ny, moz-GI, BYS-try, ROST, bol-shin-STVO, PROS-to, PA-da-yut, E-tu, PRO-past
audio.pacing: speech runs unbroken 0.00 to 7.20, first word on the first frame, no gap between beats; after 7.20 wind, scree and paper fill the track to 10.00
audio.lip_sync: his jaw opens on every syllable, no voice over
audio.sfx: wind over the ledge, scree sliding, paper whipping, boots scraping

timeline.a: he is already driving along the ledge in the first frame, the cliff raking past, ONE suit plunging across the glass a shoulder away
he sweeps his corkscrew horns across the lens, another suit dropping past behind them
he shoulders through the queue along the ledge, the orbit whipping to his flank
he strides on and a suit crosses the glass, contracts whipping off it across the lens
he swings his beard across frame as the orbit whips to his other side, the cliff raking the lens
he rides the orbit at the lens, the whole column tipping past the glass in a grey sheet
the last investor grabs his horn and he flings him across the lens into the fog, the briefcase after him
he launches sideways across the chasm, fog streaming under him, and slams into the bark of the pine on the far wall
he walks straight up the near-vertical rock, scree and contracts sheeting past the lens, his muzzle into the glass

must_appear: at 0.00 he is already striding, a suit already plunging across the glass; a suit crosses the lens in every beat; nothing touches him before 7.20; he leaps the chasm sideways at 8.20 and climbs the near-vertical rock by 9.20; every word spoken, the last by 7.20; jaw open on every syllable
negative_prompt: subtitles, watermark, letterbox, horizontal frame, night, dark scene, a static camera, a still background, a still first frame, a held pose, a parked hero, a hero standing motionless on the rock, a hero moving up or down the frame, a wide or distant hero, standing bystanders, slow motion, letters, digits, a word not in the lines, a closed jaw while speaking, anything touching him before 7.20, multiple markhors, foreign accent
